newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha off as some Skikda loadings suspended.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha off as some Skikda loadings suspended.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were pressured lower on Thursday as a suspension on double stem cargo loadings out of Skikda threatened to leave material earmarked for Asia stranded in Europe, traders said.
May swaps were talked at $176.50/$178 a tonne, roughly $1.50 lower than Wednesday.
Traders said the suspension was connected to loading and storage logistics at the port.
The move was expected to weigh on the European market because the Asian arbitrage door is only open to double stem cargoes at the moment, they said.
"A number of players were looking to work the arb with larger cargoes," said one trader. "The material may well have to stay in Europe."
